changes.title: Music studio
items: New: the Music Studio (music-studio.html beside the game), for designing the game's synth sounds and hearing a MIDI file from Logic played on them through the game's own engine. The game's music is unchanged.

changes.title: Telescope
items: The telescope in the crow's nest works: press E at it to look out over the whole island, turning all the way round and zooming in on the far side, while the night carries on slowly; E or Esc to stop looking

changes.title: Dress before door
items: The bedroom curtains open by themselves once the island has loaded, unlocking the door
The bedroom is bigger, with everything you can wear except your hat, bag and broom in it, so you can get dressed before the door opens
Hats, bags and brooms are in the shared rooms past the door (there'll be a bedroom each when friends join)
